name: homie
description: A studio in a box on your own Cloudflare: set up a studio (one repository for games, music, videos and posts), make or remix multiplayer web games or make an existing single-player game multiplayer, make songs and game scores with ElevenLabs Music on your own account, make gameplay trailers and music videos (captured from your game, or generated with fal on your own account, under a budget with receipts), run the studio's site and public rooms (up to 32 players a room) on its own Cloudflare account (free plan, no payment method), list it in the homie.rocks directory, and read the studio's own stats (counts, never tracking). Beta.

interface.shortDescription: Studios for games, music and video on your own Cloudflare
interface.longDescription: Set up a studio as one repository (games, music, videos, posts), make or remix multiplayer web games, make an existing single-player web game multiplayer where strangers meet in public rooms (every browser renders, bots fill seats, rounds restart), make songs and game scores with ElevenLabs Music on your own account, make gameplay trailers and music videos (captured from your game, or generated with fal on your own account, under a budget with receipts), preview locally, deploy the studio's site to its own Cloudflare account on the free plan (no payment method), and list the games in the homie.rocks directory. Beta: report issues at github.com/homie-rocks/homie/issues.
